# Offline layout reference

The layout contract in `scripts/check-masonry-browser.js` models selected CSS
declarations from **🧱 X.com Masonry View 1.7.7**, published under `@license MIT`:

- Source: https://greasyfork.org/en/scripts/597544-x-com-masonry-view
- Upstream namespace: https://greasyfork.org/users/1292139

The supplied upstream file contains no additional copyright notice. Its
React, networking, and optimization implementation is not included or executed.
XPostSaver's runtime compatibility and hint implementation is original.
